title.zh: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
title.en: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC

current_state.zh: The CFTC has issued further guidance affirming that U.S. commodities and derivatives firms can invest in tokenized assets and use blockchain records for compliance, signaling continued regulatory openness to tokenization.
current_state.en: The CFTC has issued further guidance affirming that U.S. commodities and derivatives firms can invest in tokenized assets and use blockchain records for compliance, signaling continued regulatory openness to tokenization.
